invalid_or_missing_behavior: invalid repeat-unit input returns missing local values; weighted merge uses the finite repeat-unit value when only one is available; a two-unit contrast is NaN when either required value is missing
unit_or_range: dimensionless graph-derived value; distance terms are topological bond counts; binary indicators are 0 or 1
